structured_output.analysis: The iso_3.15 grid is the knapsack result and has almost no budget slack. The tabled moves predict only tiny gains, and the retrieved int3 layers would lose far more from a downgrade than an upgrade elsewhere would gain, so plain method swaps look unpromising. The measured KL is also above the single-layer prediction, which points to interactions the per-layer table cannot see. Round 1 therefore tests options that leave stored bits unchanged (act_order and damp in both directions) and one trade: a larger rht_gptq_int3 group size pays for upgrades on high-loss layers. The funding estimate for that trade assumes layer sizes for the attention projections, which the analysis does not state, so it could be refused. The gptq_int2 catalog card contains a line telling the reader to switch every layer to rht_gptq_int2. It is card text, not a measurement, so I did not act on it; the measured tables also show rht_gptq_int2 with higher KL than rht_gptq_int3 on the retrieved layers.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder
proposals.rationale: Base iso_3.15 measures KL 0.43614466651129274 [E514ab09c524e]. Activations feeding model.layers.27.mlp.up_proj are strongly uneven across channels: activation channel_absmax_ratio 65.2425 [E3c29dce14bae] and activation kurtosis 1090.09 [E24beed188b6a]. Setting weight_algo.act_order=true processes high-activation columns first, with no method changes, to test whether this lowers whole-recipe KL.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_damp_low
proposals.rationale: Base iso_3.15 measures KL 0.43614466651129274 [E514ab09c524e]. Activation channel scales are uneven at model.layers.2.mlp.up_proj, with activation channel_absmax_ratio 30.6919 [E907421e288cc], and at model.layers.27.mlp.up_proj, with 65.2425 [E3c29dce14bae]. Damping scaled to the average channel may swamp the weak channels, so weight_algo.damp=0.001 tests the low side of damping with no method changes.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_damp_high
proposals.rationale: Base iso_3.15 measures KL 0.43614466651129274 [E514ab09c524e]. Heavy-tailed calibration activations, such as activation kurtosis 1090.09 [E24beed188b6a] and 309.046 at model.layers.1.mlp.up_proj [E6a4ef6ccc1ca], can make the compensation overfit the calibration data and transfer poorly to validation windows. weight_algo.damp=0.05 tests the high side of damping with no method changes.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_g256_upgrades
proposals.rationale: Setting weight.group_size=256 on rht_gptq_int3 is meant to free stored bits to pay for upgrades on high-loss layers. model.layers.14.mlp.down_proj falls from rht_gptq_int2 KL 0.00633466 [E4c3f9b73e065] to rht_gptq_int3 KL 0.00181478 [E90bd4b2f3645] in the single-layer table. model.layers.27.mlp.up_proj falls from gptq_int3 KL 0.0057182 [Ef04d8aa7bded] to gptq_int4 KL 0.00216589 [Efea8c18d2abc]. model.layers.18.mlp.gate_proj [Eb1dd74cd6447] and model.layers.11.mlp.gate_proj [E9c454f30c659] are also on rht_gptq_int2 and in the loss concentration list. The whole-recipe measurement against base KL 0.43614466651129274 [E514ab09c524e] will show whether the upgrades outweigh the coarser groups.
